metrics.summary: Fixed NameAliasMixin.get_real_name() in sqlparse/sql.py: instead of finding only the first dot (so it returned the name after the first dot, e.g. `schema` for `db.schema.tbl.col`), it now loops with `token_next_by(m=(T.Punctuation, '.'), idx=...)` to find the *last* dot, then calls `_get_first_name` on the tokens after it. Verified: `db.schema.tbl.col` -> real/name `col`, `x.y.z AS w` -> real `z`, alias `w`, `a.b` still -> `b`, `mydb.sch.func(1)` -> real `func`, and `get_parent_name()` still returns the first part (`db`). Full test suite passes (489 passed, 2 xfailed, 1 xpassed — same xfail/xpass behavior as before, pre-existing).
